post.description: Writes one operation-owned test row through the production row codec, reads it back, then removes only that row. Results keep write verification and cleanup status separate.
post.summary: Confirm a write-group test write

200.description: written_verified, written_unverified, failed or unknown, with cleanup_status

409.description: stale or expired first claim, or another operation holds the table

422.description: token for another action, or unsupported target

503.description: code=WRITE_GROUP_TEST_WRITE_RESULT_UNKNOWN; the result could not be recorded

post.description: Returns the test row, its operation-owned cleanup and an action-bound token without changing the target.
post.summary: Preview a write-group test write

422.description: code=WRITE_GROUP_TEST_WRITE_UNSUPPORTED; the target cannot safely identify and remove an operation-owned test row

get.description: Returns the durable state of a schema operation issued by a preview of the current workspace.

parameters.description: Operation ID returned with the schema preview
parameters.name: operation_id

200.description: success=true; data is the schema operation

404.description: success=false; code=RECORDING_OPERATION_NOT_FOUND; unknown or foreign operation

post.description: Executes a current schema preview once on a verified adapter and returns the verified operation; repeated confirmations return the recorded operation.
post.summary: Apply the managed recording schema

200.description: success=true; data is the finished schema operation (succeeded, partial, failed or unknown)

202.description: success=true; data is the schema operation that is still running

400.description: Missing token, operation_id or expected revisions

409.description: success=false; code=RECORDING_SCHEMA_PREVIEW_STALE, RECORDING_SCHEMA_PREVIEW_EXPIRED, RECORDING_CONNECTOR_REVISION_CONFLICT, RECORDING_SCHEMA_OPERATION_MISMATCH or RECORDING_SCHEMA_OPERATION_BUSY

422.description: success=false; incompatible target, missing permission or disabled connector

501.description: success=false; code=RECORDING_SCHEMA_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; the adapter has no verified managed schema execution

503.description: success=false; code=RECORDING_SCHEMA_OPERATION_UNKNOWN (operation_id names the unresolved operation) or RECORDING_SCHEMA_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE

cleanup.description: Cleanup describes the only rows the operation removes afterwards.

payload_digest.description: Test-write facts. They stay empty for schema operations.

entity_key.description:
EntityKey is the raw legacy group key used only to partition buffered
rows. It is deliberately not interpreted as a destination SQL value.
